description: This file defines a React component-based notification system with context, hooks, and UI components for displaying notifications of various types (success, error, warning, info) including specific hooks for DID and VC notifications.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Interface representing a notification object with properties like id, type, title, message, duration, action, and persistent.

classes.name: NotificationContextType
classes.description: Interface defining the shape of the notification context, including notifications array and functions to add, remove, and clear notifications.

classes.name: NotificationProviderProps
classes.description: Props interface for NotificationProvider component, expecting children of type ReactNode.

classes.name: NotificationItemProps
classes.description: Props interface for NotificationItem component, including notification object and onClose callback.

methods.name: useNotifications
methods.description: Custom hook to access notification context, throws error if used outside provider.

methods.name: NotificationProvider
methods.description: Component providing notification context to children, managing notification state and auto-removal.

methods.name: NotificationContainer
methods.description: Component rendering active notifications in a fixed position.

methods.name: NotificationItem
methods.description: Component rendering individual notification with animation, styles based on type, and close functionality.

methods.name: useSuccessNotification
methods.description: Hook returning function to trigger success notifications.

methods.name: useErrorNotification
methods.description: Hook returning function to trigger error notifications.

methods.name: useInfoNotification
methods.description: Hook returning function to trigger info notifications.

methods.name: useWarningNotification
methods.description: Hook returning function to trigger warning notifications.

methods.name: useDIDNotifications
methods.description: Hook providing specific functions for DID-related notifications.

methods.name: useVCNotifications
methods.description: Hook providing specific functions for Verifiable Credential-related notifications.
